tools.name: record_measurement

sample_code.description: Sample identifier within the active experiment.

value.description: The numeric value. Must be finite.

unit.description: Unit of measure. Omit only if the protocol step resolves it.

raw_spoken_value.description: Verbatim transcription of what the user said.

tools.name: get_next_protocol_step
tools.description: Return the next approved protocol step from stored state. Never invent steps.
